name: responses-chatgpt-sign-in
note: Upstream 02eed88fd (Go d8532cc): a credential sent to OpenAI itself (provider openai, baseUrl https://api.openai.com/v1) that is not an "sk-" API key is a Sign in with ChatGPT access token, and token sharing rejects max_output_tokens, temperature and prompt_cache_retention, so both sides omit them; prompt_cache_key still goes. The other openai-provider scenarios use "sk-test-key" so they keep covering those fields, as upstream switched its own tests to "sk-" keys.
